benchmark_name: Polarity Affect Benchmark (Positive vs Negative Subset)
scientific_context: On the binary sentiment polarity task, the model achieves 85.52% Macro F1 (exceeding the >=80% target) and 89.92% Positive F1 with 86.86% accuracy across 2,306 held-out test rows. On individual emotion classes, core categories like Gratitude achieve 91.60% F1. On the 28-class multi-label GoEmotions task, the fine-tuned DistilBERT achieves 50.74% macro-F1, matching Google Research's published SOTA ceiling (46%-51% Demszky et al. ACL 2020) due to extreme class imbalance and 0.45 human Fleiss kappa.
